sentences.en: The situation has improved considerably compared with what it was.
sentences.zh: 情况相比以前有了显著改善。

sentences.en: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
sentences.zh: 我们罢工是因为公司没有提高我们的工资。

sentences.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
sentences.zh: 这项举措明显提高了村民的生活质量。

senses.zh: 改进；增加（improve的过去式和过去分词）；变得更好
